We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Pv & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 3 \\ 1 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot 0+(-1)\cdot 4+2\cdot (-1) \\ 1\cdot 0+(-1)\cdot 4+3\cdot (-1) \\ 1\cdot 0+(-1)\cdot 4+4\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0-4-2 \\ 0-4-3 \\ 0-4-4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ -7 \\ -8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
